$description: The site's border widths. `thin` is the one width nearly everything uses — the hairline under --border-thickness in variables.css, which button.css, code.css and 18 other bordered things inherit. Read by tailwind.config.js (emits --border-width-*) and by build-penpot-tokens.js (emits border.* into core/layout). Icon stroke weights are NOT this token: those belong to the icon artwork, not the border system.
